notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.content:
In the spirit of the holiday, we bring you plenty of goodies. There are new [b]Christmas levels[/b], new [b]achievement[/b] (and some of the old ones fixed and provided with description), and [b]trading cards[/b] are well on the way.

[b]Have fun and happy holidays![/b] ːsteamhappyː

[img]http://www.phime.com/files/dalehd/social/christmas_update.jpg[/img]
